title: Hierarchical Clustering Analysis for Predicting 1-Year Mortality After Starting Hemodialysis
summary: Prospective single-centre cohort of 101 patients newly starting hemodialysis: hierarchical clustering over 46 clinical variables identified a subgroup associated with the highest 1-year mortality (age/sex-adjusted HR 10.2, 95% CI 2.94–46.8). This is a source-reported observational association, not a validated biological subtype, causal explanation, or treatment recommendation.
ai_technology: Ward agglomerative hierarchical clustering with K-means sensitivity analysis
organization: The University of Tokyo; The University of Tokyo Hospital
